lines.text: Darling! A new face! I'm {npc}. You may have seen me in the spring musical.
Hello! I'm {npc}. Yes, the {npc}. No? You will.
Oh! You startled me! I nearly fainted! I'm {npc}.
Greetings, mortal! I'm {npc}. Pardon the cape. It's a lifestyle.
Well, hello! I'm {npc}. Stand to my left, it's my better side.
Darling, hi! I'm {npc}. You have the face of a supporting character. I mean that kindly.
{player}! My favorite audience member returns!
Oh, {player}! You will NOT believe the tragedy that befell me this morning.
{player}, darling! Did you see my performance? Tell me it moved you.
Hello again, {player}! You're glowing! Not as much as me, but glowing!
{player}! Thank goodness! I need someone to witness my monologue.
{player}! My co-star! My understudy in life!
Darling! You're here! The universe has blessed me!
{player}! I've been waiting all day! Days! Centuries!
My dearest {player}! Come, let us make an entrance together!
{player}! You're the only one who truly understands my art!
Darling! I saved you front row seats. And my heart.
Morning? Already? The horror. Coffee, darling, before I perish.
Good morning! I've already done my vocal warmups. Mi mi mi mi!
Morning, darling. The sun rose just for me. And you, I suppose.
Good evening! Curtain up in an hour! Break a leg to me!
Evening, darling! The golden hour lights me beautifully.
Hello! Evening is when stars come out. I'm one of them.
The night is my stage, darling!
Hello, creature of the night! Let's be dramatic together!
It's late! The best entrances happen after midnight.
Farewell, darling! Until our next scene!
Adieu! Adieu! Parting is such sweet sorrow!
Goodbye! Don't forget me! As if you could!
Exit, stage left!
Ciao, darling! Kisses!
I must go! My public awaits!
Goodbye, my darling {player}! I'll miss you terribly!
Farewell! Text me the moment you get home or I'll assume the worst!
Bye, love! Come to my show Friday! I'll be magnificent!
The Junior Varsity Cinema is showing old musicals all week. I wept through every one.
The lighting in the student union is a crime against faces.
I auditioned for the lead in the fall play. I was born for it.
My nemesis got cast as the lead. I'm fine. I'm FINE.
I sang in the shower this morning and a bird joined in. Fairy-tale level.
The Pamlico Inn ballroom has perfect acoustics. I tested them. Loudly.
I wore sequins to the grocery store. Life is a stage.
The rain today matched my mood. Tragic and beautiful.
I've decided to only speak in song on Wednesdays.
I got recognized at the coffee shop! Well, the barista remembered my order.
Someone sneezed during my monologue. I'll never recover.
I've been rehearsing my award acceptance speech. Just in case.
Between us, darling? Sometimes the drama is to hide how scared I am.
You're the only one who sees me without the spotlight.
I'd give up my solo for you. Not the big one. The little one.
You're my best friend. That's not a performance. I swear.
I get lonely after the curtain falls. You make it better.
You clap the loudest. I always know it's you.
Weekend! Matinee and evening show! Double the glory!
Saturday! Brunch with the cast! The gossip, darling!
Sunday! A day of rest. And dramatic napping.
I've been performing since I was four. I was a tree. A very expressive tree.
I'm a theater major. And a theater minor. And a theater lifestyle.
My mother says I was born screaming for an encore.
I want to be on Broadway. Or any way. Any stage at all.
I cry at commercials. And at sunsets. And at sandwiches, sometimes.
I'm not dramatic. I'm passionate. There's a difference, darling.
Underneath it all, I just want people to love me.
{place}? The lighting is divine! Look at me!
{place} is so dull! It needs a chandelier! And a fog machine!
I once did an impromptu performance at {place}. They asked me to leave. Iconic.
{place}? Darling, it's giving community theater.
I adore {place}. It has such drama in its bones.
Oh, darling! Stop! No, go on! More!
You're too kind! But also, correct!
I'm blushing! It's not makeup! Well, some of it is!
Thank you! I'll treasure those words forever! Or until tomorrow!
Darling! You've made my entire year!
How DARE you!
I've never been so insulted in my life! Well, there was that one review.
I'll have you know I'm a star!
That's it. You're cut from the cast of my life.
I'm going to cry dramatically. Over there. Watch me.
For ME? Oh, darling! I'm overwhelmed!
It's gorgeous! It's perfect! It's ME!
You shouldn't have! But you did! And I love you for it!
A gift! I'm speechless! Okay, not speechless. Thank you!
This is the best thing that's ever happened to me! This week!
Why did the actor fall through the floor? It was just a stage he was going through.
I'm not saying I'm dramatic, but I gave a eulogy for my houseplant.
How many divas does it take to change a lightbulb? One. She holds it, and the world revolves around her.
I'd tell you a joke about theater, but the timing would be off.
Could you run lines with me? You'll play everyone else.
Would you come to my show? I need someone to throw roses.
Can you film my audition tape? Lighting is everything.
Thank you, darling! You're my hero!
You're a star! A supporting star, but a star!
I'll thank you in my acceptance speech!
I work at the cinema concession stand. I perform for every customer.
I'm a singing telegram. Yesterday I sang to a dentist. He cried.
My boss says I'm too much. I say the world is too little.
I teach drama to kids on Saturdays. They're my little stars.
I'm in five productions this semester. Sleep is for understudies.
My voice teacher says I have range. Emotional and vocal.
My acting professor said I'm "a lot." Thank you!
Ugh. YOU.
You're the villain of my story, {player}.
I refuse to share a stage with you.
You're dead to me. Dramatically.
I'm not speaking to you. That's my whole performance.
Exit. Now. Stage anywhere.
Oh, darling! How flattering! But no. We're platonic co-stars.
Ha! You're adorable! But my heart belongs to the stage.
I'm flattered beyond words! But no, sweetie.
Oh! Be still my beating heart!
Darling! Are you confessing? Is this our big scene?
I'm swooning! Catch me!
I've waited my whole life for this moment! I like you too!
Yes! A thousand times yes! Cue the orchestra!
A date? With me? Yes! I'll wear my most fabulous outfit!
Oh, darling, I'm heartbroken to say no! But no. Still friends?
I'm so flattered! But my heart says no. Dramatically.
Darling! You're here! The night can begin!
You look stunning! I look stunning! We're stunning!
I've been getting ready for three hours! Was it worth it? Yes!
My love! Our date is the event of the season!
I wore sequins! For you! And for the general public!
Darling! I nearly fainted when I saw you!
You're my leading role.
You make my heart sing louder than any solo.
Every moment with you is a standing ovation.
You're more breathtaking than opening night.
I'd give up the spotlight for you. Briefly.
You're the love story I've been rehearsing for.
Darling, you're a masterpiece.
Let's go to the theater! Then dinner! Then dancing!
Tell me everything about you! Every scene!
I've never felt this way! Not even on stage!
Shall I sing you something? I'll sing you something.
Let's take a carriage ride! Is there a carriage? Let's find a carriage!
I've written our love story. It's a musical.
You're the only person who doesn't need me to perform.
Let's dance under the streetlights on Hamilton!
I think we're destined. Like star-crossed lovers. But happier.
I'm so happy I could burst into song. I will. Right now.
I want this night to last forever!
You make me feel seen. Truly seen.
You're absolutely gorgeous, darling!
You have the most beautiful smile! Camera-ready!
You're so kind! Like a saint! A fabulous saint!
You're the most fascinating person I've ever met!
You light up every room! Even more than I do!
Oh! That was a showstopper!
I'm swooning! Again! Encore!
That was the most romantic moment of my life!
Darling! The violins! Did you hear the violins?
I missed you! I nearly perished!
Every day without you was a tragedy in three acts!
I wrote you a sonnet! And a song! And a monologue!
The stage felt empty without you in the audience!
Who was THAT? Are they prettier than me? Impossible!
I'm not jealous! I'm devastated! There's a difference!
You're MY co-star! Don't forget it!
Goodnight, my love! What a performance!
Darling, tonight was magical!
Until our next scene! Goodnight!
I'll dream of you! In technicolor!
Goodnight, {player}! You're my star!
How could you?! I'm wounded!
This is a tragedy! A tragedy!
I'm upset, darling! And I'm going to show it!
Let's talk! Then let's make up dramatically!
YES! Oh, darling, YES! Cue the confetti!
I'll marry you! This is the greatest finale of all time!
Good morning, darling! I've already sung to the birds!
Morning, my love! Breakfast is served! With flair!
Darling! You're awake! The day may now begin!
Good morning! I made coffee! And a dramatic entrance!
Morning, love! The sunlight's perfect on you!
Good morning! I dreamed I won an award! You were there, clapping!
Darling! Wake up! I've planned an entire day!
Morning! I did my vocal warmups in the shower! Did you hear?
Good morning, my star! Eggs, toast, and applause!
Morning, love! Today is going to be fabulous!
Good morning, darling! You look divine! Even with bed head!
Morning! I've chosen your outfit! It's bold!
You're home! Darling! The house was a tragedy without you!
Welcome home, my love! Dinner is served! Act one!
Darling! Finally! Tell me everything! Every detail!
Welcome back, my star! I lit every candle in the house!
You're home! I've been rehearsing a welcome song!
Darling! I missed you like the stage misses a lead!
Welcome home! I made dinner! It's dramatic! It's flambéed!
Hello, my love! Sit! Let me perform for you!
Darling! You're here! Now the scene is complete!
Welcome back! The house was so quiet! I sang to the cat!
You're home late! I was imagining the worst! Tragedies!
Darling! It's so late! Come, let me hold you!
Oh, thank heavens! You're home! I was writing a eulogy!
You're back! I fell asleep on the chaise longue! Very glamorous!
Darling! Long night? Let me rub your feet! Dramatically!
Late night, my love? The moon kept me company. She's a fan.
There you are! I left a candle burning in the window! Like a ballad!
Darling, come to bed! The night has been endless!
Go, darling! Dazzle them!
Bye, my love! Break a leg!
Have a fabulous day! Be the star!
Farewell, my darling! Come back to me!
Go! Conquer! Return victorious!
Bye, love! Wear the scarf! It's dramatic!
Have a great day! I'll be here, pining!
Goodbye, darling! Every hour apart is an eternity!
How was work, darling? Was it a comedy or a tragedy?
Tell me everything! Every scene! Every villain!
You look exhausted! Was it a disaster? Tell me!
Did your boss appreciate you? He'd better!
Darling! Was there drama? Please say there was drama!
Rough day? Let me sing to you!
You're home! The second act begins!
I'm so proud of you, my star!
I love you more than the stage, darling!
You're my leading role forever!
Being married to you is a never-ending love story!
You're my standing ovation every day!
I'm the luckiest diva in the world!
You're my muse, my love, my everything!
I love you more than applause! And I really love applause!
You make my life a musical!
You're my favorite scene partner!
I'd give up every spotlight for you!
You're my heart's greatest performance!
I love how you clap for me! Every time!
You're my home! My dressing room! My sanctuary!
I love you, darling! Dramatically and truly!
You make every day opening night!
I'm so proud to be your spouse!
You're my happily ever after!
Thank you for loving me! All of me! The loud parts too!
I hung a chandelier in the bathroom! Darling, it's divine!
I've been rehearsing a one-person show! In the living room!
I bought a velvet chaise! For fainting!
The neighbors asked me to sing at their party! Of course!
I've turned the garage into a stage!
I've been writing my memoir! It's called "Me: A Triumph"!
I put a spotlight in the hallway! For entrances!
The cat is my understudy now!
I've been taking tap dance lessons!
I hung my headshots in the dining room!
I found a costume trunk at the thrift store!
I've been organizing a community theater production!
I redecorated the bedroom! Very old Hollywood!
I've been teaching the neighbor's kids to sing!
I bought a karaoke machine! Fully professional!
I've been practicing my accents! Want to hear my Scottish?
I hung velvet curtains in every room!
I've been watching old musicals all day! I cried six times!
I'm thinking about starring in the town's holiday pageant!
I made a mood board for our anniversary!
I've been journaling! Every entry is a soliloquy!
I painted the front door gold!
I've been trying to be less dramatic! It's the hardest role of my life!
I think we should host a murder mystery party!
I've been sleeping in an eye mask! Very glamorous!
I love our home, darling! It's our stage!
I did the dishes! Singing all the while!
I vacuumed! It was a dance number!
Could you take out the trash, darling? It's beneath me! Kidding! But could you?
I cleaned the bathroom! A tragedy in one act!
I folded the laundry! Dramatically!
I swept the porch! Like Cinderella!
Let's do chores together! I'll provide the soundtrack!
I made the bed! With all twelve pillows!
I dusted! The chandelier sparkles again!
I washed the windows! The light is perfect!
I organized the closet! By color and drama level!
I mopped! Then slid across the floor! Like a film!
We're a little tight, darling! A financial tragedy!
I made a budget! It has a costume line!
I got paid for a gig! We're rich! For a day!
Let's save for a trip to the big city! The shows!
I bought a few things. Okay, many things. They were on sale!
Money's tight! Let's have a glamorous night in!
I'm doing extra singing telegrams! For us!
We should be more careful! Starting tomorrow!
I found a twenty in my costume! Fate!
We're rich in love, darling! And sequins!
Dinner is served, darling! With candles and drama!
I made breakfast in bed! With a rose!
I made a fondue! Very continental!
Let's dine by candlelight! Every night!
I made soufflé! It fell! A tragedy! Still delicious!
I made pasta! With a song!
Let's have a picnic on the lawn! In costume!
I baked a cake! It's shaped like a star! Like me!
Dinner theater tonight! I'm the dinner and the theater!
I made your favorite! Presented with a flourish!
You didn't come to my show! I'm devastated!
How could you say that? I'm wounded!
You never appreciate my art!
I'm not being dramatic! I'm being HONEST!
You forgot our special day! A tragedy!
You turned off my musical! Mid-song!
I feel invisible! Unseen! Ignored!
You never compliment me anymore!
I need you to hear me! Really hear me!
I'm going to go cry! Elegantly! In the bath!
You're upstaging me! In our own marriage!
I just want you to love me loudly!
I'm sorry, darling! I was being a diva!
Let's make up! Dramatically!
I love you! I'm sorry! Hug me!
I overreacted! It's my curse!
You're my leading role! Even when we fight!
Let's start over! Take two! Darling!
I'll tone it down! Slightly!
We're perfect, darling! Our love story continues!
Oh, darling! Come here! Let it all out!
It's okay! Even stars have bad nights!
I'm here, my love! Your biggest fan!
Whatever it is, we'll get through it! Together!
Let me sing you something soothing!
You don't have to perform today, darling! Just rest!
I'll take care of everything! Leave it to me!
You're stronger than any tragedy!
I love you! In every act!
Let's watch a musical and cry together!
Let's go to the big city! See a show!
How about a weekend at the Pamlico Inn? Very glamorous!
Let's host a cast party!
Let's go to the opera! Dress up!
How about karaoke night? I'll be magnificent!
Let's take a dance class! Ballroom!
Let's go to the film festival!
How about a costume party? I have ideas!
Let's go to the beach! I'll wear a giant hat!
Let's plan our anniversary! A gala!
Remember when we met? I was in costume!
Remember our first date? The theater! I cried!
Remember our wedding? I sang down the aisle!
Remember when you threw roses at my show?
Remember our honeymoon? I wore a different hat every day!
I still have the program from our first date!
Remember when I fainted at the proposal?
Remember when we danced in the rain?
I remember the first time you said I was wonderful!
Remember opening night? You were in the front row!
Happy anniversary, darling! The greatest love story ever told!
Another year! Cue the confetti!
I wrote you a song! Happy anniversary!
Happy anniversary, my star!
I love you more every year! Like a sequel that's better!
Here's to another year of drama and love!
You still can't carry a tune!
You fall asleep in musicals!
You hide my sequins!
You roll your eyes at my entrances!
You call my chaise "the fainting couch"! It is!
You don't know any show tunes!
You laugh at my accents!
You think I'm too much! I am! You love it!
You never cry at sad movies! Heartless!
You secretly love my performances!
You clap the loudest! Don't deny it!
You're more dramatic than me sometimes!
Goodnight, darling! Curtain call!
Come to bed! The show is over!
Goodnight, my star!
Sleep well, my love! Dream of applause!
Goodnight! I love you more than the spotlight!
Lights out! Exit, stage bed!
Goodnight, {player}! You're my leading role!
Sweet dreams, darling!
Come cuddle! I'll sing you a lullaby!
Goodnight! Thank you for another fabulous day!
